Trigger Warnings. We used to call these "Disclaimers" and what they were originally intended to do was inform the audience that there may be content which the audience member may not wish to consume. Instead what this has done has made it a tool for complete and total censorship of any viewpoint they may disagree with even if it is presented in a manner that should never consititute a disclaimer much less a warning.

Nobody walked out, and nobody got censored.

Including a trigger warning doesn't prevent discourse- it could, in fact, promote it. No topic needs to be off-limits- there can just be a quick heads-up that there's going to be some sensitive stuff discussed.
